versions.changelog:
community-group-buying-team-operation v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a full-chain community group leader (团长) operation skillset: recruitment, tiering, incentives, training, platform differences, attrition warning, and supporting tools.
- Provides detailed models and benchmarks to classify group leaders, compare major platforms (美团优选, 多多买菜, 兴盛优选, 淘菜菜), and establish recruitment/retention SOPs.
- Includes group leader motivation systems, multi-stage training curriculum, and early-warning/retention methods for group leader attrition.
- Bundles a practical commission calculator tool for income estimation.
- Excludes product selection and supply chain modules for clear module boundaries.
